errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.description: Caller lacks required permissions. Includes rejection when `issuer` equals `subject` in `create_attestation`.

errors.name: InvalidThreshold
errors.description: Threshold must be >= 1 and <= number of required signers.

errors.name: NotRequiredSigner
errors.description: The signer is not in the proposal's required_signers list.

errors.name: AlreadySigned
errors.description: The signer has already co-signed this proposal.

errors.name: ProposalFinalized
errors.description: The proposal has already been finalized.

errors.name: ProposalExpired
errors.description: The proposal has expired without reaching threshold.

errors.name: ReasonTooLong
errors.description: The revocation reason exceeds the maximum allowed length of 128 characters.

errors.name: CannotEndorseOwn
errors.description: Endorser cannot endorse their own attestation.

errors.name: AlreadyEndorsed
errors.description: Endorser has already endorsed this attestation.

errors.name: ContractPaused
errors.description: The contract is paused; write operations are temporarily disabled.

errors.name: SubjectNotWhitelisted
errors.description: Subject is not on the issuer's whitelist and the issuer has whitelist mode enabled.

errors.name: InvalidClaimType
errors.description: Claim type string is empty, too long, or contains disallowed characters.

errors.name: InvalidJurisdiction
errors.description: Jurisdiction code is not a valid ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code.

errors.name: RateLimited
errors.description: Issuer has exceeded the minimum issuance interval (rate limit).

errors.name: LimitExceeded
errors.description: Storage limit exceeded for issuer or subject.

errors.name: ProposalCancelled
errors.description: The proposal has been cancelled by the proposer.

errors.name: InvalidSourceReference
errors.description: Source reference string is missing or empty.
